slice: C3: exact repeated integer extension selection
specification: EvoMIR 0.63 selection policy; no new opcode meaning, interpreter, registry, allocator or verifier semantics.

behavior.scope: Reuse exact unique-definition, local non-edge Extend, low Bfx and contiguous-low-mask AND results before allocation. Reset availability at blocks and every non-discardable instruction; preserve classes, widths, signedness and effect barriers.
behavior.excluded: C2 local selection remains outside the admitted cumulative arm after its frozen cost miss. Protected/kernel and frame-pointer profiles keep prior output.

focused.scope: MIR/interpreter/allocation negatives and exact-IR adapter; 48 native Darwin MIR functions x 1024 inputs; Linux assembly for all 48.

driver.scope: Public Linux driver, crossed calls for signed char and unsigned short.

red.result: EXPECTED_FAILURE: OFF contains three byte or two halfword extensions; extensions option initially unavailable.

gates.lean: NOT_REQUIRED: no Lean or registry change

prior_attempts.disposition: INVALID_CROSS_TARGET_PROBE_NOT_PASS: Linux signed narrow C signatures were retargeted to Darwin without the frontend sign extension required by EvoMIR section 6. OFF and both ON variants returned 1920 for -128, Darwin Clang returned -1920. No production semantics or expected value was changed; the replacement test uses the supported Linux public driver. Original probe and diagnostic remain.

native_corpora.scope: Both named 384-case populations execute and agree; each object twin is identical. No general Darwin signed-narrow C frontend bridge or full-program proof claim.

bounds.steps: All 257 step records and all six IR/chain/bundle bindings per arm equal T3; native selection only.
bounds.sampling: One frozen cohort, three compile observations, two object builds, no resampling.

attribution.c3: Only extension/mask bytes change in extensions-only versus OFF and in cumulative versus T3. No new frame, move, spill, constant, padding, literal-pool or rodata savings. B unchecked savings in frozen unit order: 0/8/4/0/0/0 bytes.
attribution.denominator: The old 2.04..2.43 range was per-family, not per-TU. The 1.4 target is evaluated on each of the six units; no cross-family mean.
attribution.claims: N01 categories are syntactic attribution. C3 is native selection, not verified EqSat gain.

disk.scope: Cache plus final retained C3 evidence; retired owned intermediates already excluded. Tracked files/Git and unrelated filesystem activity excluded. No previous-slice payload was removed or charged twice.

package_disposition.c2: Frozen compile-bound miss (1.7977x), not admitted; not resampled or included in cumulative options.
package_disposition.c3: Closed opt-in, small measured benefit. All five library TUs still exceed 1.4x GCC-O2.
package_disposition.unimplemented: No general conditional-compare MIR instruction or CFG if-conversion was added. Existing compared-value CSEL, immediate/checked branch fusion and fallthrough remain baseline, not new gains. General CCMP/control restructuring needs a separately specified flags/effects and admission design or a separately bounded emission rule; it is not claimed implemented or proved. No broader selection redesign in this slice.
package_disposition.remaining: C2's unexamined compare/control opportunities still need a bounded measured disposition. C3 does not close them merely because its own tests passed.

claim_ceiling: Bounded opt-in native selection with finite correctness tests and small per-TU size gains. Not universal backend correctness, SMT proof, a general Darwin C frontend ABI bridge, default/release admission, full applications, kernel/latency acceptance, complete instruction selection, or achievement of the 1.4 product target.
